title: Xibalba
scroll_label: Table; can be moved sideways if it is wider than the screen
too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
no_history: Counts are not kept on disk, so this page shows what happened since the last start. Set statistics.directory to see the course over time.
chart_hint: Each bar is one {unit}. Times are in UTC.
as_table: The same numbers as a table
nothing: Nothing was counted in this period.
dry_run: Dry run: decisions are counted, nothing is blocked.
saved: Saved. The change is in force.
presets_hint: Each group can be switched on or off. A change takes effect at once.
addresses_hint: An entry here comes before every rule. Addresses that are let through are also not counted by the request limits.
note_hint: Why the entry exists; only you see it
err_network_invalid: That is not an IP address or network. Examples: 192.0.2.7, 192.0.2.0/24, 2001:db8::/48.
err_network_too_large: That network is too large for this list (at most /16 for IPv4, /32 for IPv6). Use a rule in the configuration file for it.
err_network_listed: That address or network is already on the list. Remove the entry first to change it.
err_network_unknown: That entry is no longer on the list.
err_action_invalid: Choose whether the address is let through or blocked.
err_note_invalid: The note is too long (200 characters at most) or has a line break.
err_lifetime_invalid: That is not one of the durations on offer.
err_preset_unknown: There is no rule group of that name.
err_too_many: The list is full (500 entries). Remove entries you no longer need.
err_not_saved: The change could not be written to the changes file and was taken back. Check that Xibalba may write to the directory of its configuration.
preset_keep-internet-working: Lets through what the internet relies on: robots.txt, favicons, security.txt and similar well-known addresses.
preset_allow-feeds: Lets feed readers fetch RSS and Atom feeds.
preset_allow-git-clients: Lets Git fetch and push over HTTP, on the addresses Git itself uses.
preset_allow-registry-clients: For a container registry behind Xibalba: lets the programs that pull and push images use the registry's addresses.
preset_block-fake-crawlers: Blocks requests that use a known crawler's name but do not come from its operator.
preset_block-trapped: Blocks clients that followed the hidden trap link. Needs the trap to be switched on.
preset_block-ai-training: Blocks crawlers that collect pages for training AI models.
preset_block-archive-crawlers: Blocks crawlers that build public copies of the web.
preset_allow-search-engines: Lets genuine search engine crawlers through.
preset_allow-ai-search: Lets genuine crawlers of AI search services through, which show and link websites.
preset_allow-ai-user-fetch: Lets genuine AI assistants fetch a page when one of their users asks for it.
preset_weigh-odd-browsers: Adds suspicion to requests that claim to be a browser but do not behave like one. Decides nothing by itself: it needs rules.thresholds in the configuration file.
preset_challenge-browsers: Makes everything that says it is a browser pass the security check once.
